contributor to MP (1865, 68)

There are payments to Miss J. G. Hincks in the bank account. An article in the Anthropological Review 7 (April 1869) was translated from Spanish by J.G.Hincks, and since the MP work deals with Moorish material it is reasonable to see her as an expert on Spain.
